artifacts.notes: Thal'Maris concept is strong, but the skyline is too dense and too generically luminous for final use.
Arion has strong role clarity, but costume ornament and effect density reduce studio-final credibility.
Mera is emotionally clear, but the gown-like silhouette and many memory bubbles weaken practical character design.
Emilia is the strongest character-system bridge, but still needs a simpler engineered prop-forward version.
All 22 generated rows now include gate_30_score, gate_verdict, ship_status, failure_modes, and next_improvement.
Gallery rebuilt with visible gate score, verdict, ship status, and failure modes on cards.
